# At First Site Beauty

> Luxury on-location bridal hair and makeup studio serving Oregon, Washington, and the Pacific Northwest. Founded by salon owner Hollie DeMarais (VATA Salon, 18+ years) and Cedar Lapp-Ngauamo (Cedars Academy of Makeup Artistry). Specializes in bridal design sessions, wedding-day hair and makeup, bridal-party services, spray tanning, and professional teeth whitening — all delivered at the bride's venue or getting-ready location.

## Services
- [Bridal Design Session (HTML)](https://www.atfirstsitebeauty.com/bridal-design-session) · [Markdown](https://www.atfirstsitebeauty.com/bridal-design-session.md): Comprehensive in-suite trial with 6-hour wear test. Designs and locks in the wedding-day hair and makeup look.
- [Bridal Party Hair & Makeup (HTML)](https://www.atfirstsitebeauty.com/bridal-party) · [Markdown](https://www.atfirstsitebeauty.com/bridal-party.md): On-location services for the full bridal party, scaled via a Cedars-Academy-trained artist network. Seasonal pricing: $325 (Jan-Apr) / $375 (May-Dec) per person.
- [Spray Tanning (HTML)](https://www.atfirstsitebeauty.com/spray-tanning) · [Markdown](https://www.atfirstsitebeauty.com/spray-tanning.md): Pre-wedding sunless tanning with hyaluronic-acid-enriched formula. No orange undertones, 7-10 day longevity.
- [Teeth Whitening (HTML)](https://www.atfirstsitebeauty.com/teeth-whitening) · [Markdown](https://www.atfirstsitebeauty.com/teeth-whitening.md): Professional whitening service before the wedding day. Higher-percentage hydrogen peroxide with light activation.

## Team
- Hollie DeMarais — Professional bridal hairstylist and salon owner (VATA Salon, 18+ years). Bridal hair design lead.
- Cedar Lapp-Ngauamo — Founder of Cedars Academy of Makeup Artistry, the only private career college in the Pacific Northwest focused exclusively on makeup artistry. Trains and certifies every makeup artist in the network.
